cn.description:
【游戏简介】
《汉末霸业》是一款是由龙游天下工作室精心制作，一款回合制君主扮演SLG游戏。主要是以国人自己对三国游戏的新思维，新角度来打造不一样的三国世界。在回归传统策略类的基础上深度刻画了三国各城市之间的地域差异以及每个武将自身能力和特性的异同，而在战斗方面突出结合天时地利人和的调配来进行作战的魅力。

【付费说明】
有任何疑问，请加官方QQ群：604880409，咨询客服，切勿盲目操作，导致扣费！

【设备支持】
《汉末霸业》要求系统版本为iOS 16以上，并使用iPhone X及以上、iPad Air 2、iPad mini 4、iPad 2017或任意iPad Pro进行游戏。

【官方社群】
官方微博：http://weibo.com/longyougame
TapTap社区：https://www.taptap.com/app/65333
官方微信公众号：三国志汉末霸业
官方抖音：https://v.douyin.com/W4gpqG/
百度贴吧：三国志汉末霸业
官方QQ群：604880409


游戏特色

一：经典的白描绣像画风，古朴典雅

人物头像采用经典的《三国演义》连环画的白描绣像画风和上色。游戏界面采用古风古韵设计，地道中国风。

 

二：简单易上手的政务管理模式：

基础的内政安排、人事探索、军事侦察、技术开发都采用放置类管理模式，减少繁琐的重复操作，让玩家能聚焦其他事件。君主扮演模式，玩家只需要关注首都以及国家的管理。其他城市交给太守进行管理。使用方针给分城下达不同的军政指令。

 

三：极其丰富的游戏内容设定：

从公元184~280年，超过1300名登场武将（包括历史和演义武将）。 

30武将基本能力划分，对武将之间能力进行详细的差异化区分。

超过300种以上的独立配置的武将特性，全面凸显武将个体差异。 

超过500种有考据的物品宝物设定。多种分类划分来满足不同的喜好需求。

近六十多个不同类型的城市，200多种有据可考的城市特征和特产。

丰富的技术开发条目和贯穿整个游戏系统的支撑。体现了科技实力的重要性。

六大基本兵种和十多种特殊兵种构成丰富的兵种体系。

超丰富的官职系统和封侯授爵系统。

君主指派的联姻系统和人性化的子女培养及继承体系。 

各种自然现象和事件灾害模拟出多灾多难的三国时期。 

多种异民族势力和流寇山贼，需要你去平定和剿灭。 

丰富的来访事情，商人、仙人、名士、名医、名匠、剑客游走四方，引发各种功能事件。

 

四：回归经典回合制，侧重策略性排兵布阵的战斗系统

天气和地形、地块高度的引入更加凸显天时地利要素对战争的影响。

野战和攻城战功能独立分开。攻城有攻城车，霹雳车，井阑，守城有投石机、床弩、塞门刀车。更能凸显攻守之间的平衡关系。

参军特性和战场特性的引入，更加凸显三国演义中对军师角色的塑造。 

阵型系统的引入，让奇门八阵体现各自不同的辅助效果。不同的兵种搭配不同的阵型将有各异的强化效果。

隆重推荐全新制作的番外篇【苍天之志~蜀传】：
一：【苍天之志】是基于【汉末霸业】的游戏体系开发的独立番外篇，独立运行。
二：【苍天之志】是将角色扮演的RPG和战旗回合制游戏要素融合而成的新玩法。
三：玩家将自创角色，加入刘备一方。将拥有自己的封地，在游戏进程中，通过征战，获得功绩，提升地位，并不断发展和壮大实力。【注：获得用“臧霸的野望”来称呼更方便玩家的理解】
四：玩家拥有开府建牙的权利，可以去接取各种任务来获得奖励，有了收入就可以自由招揽武将，招募和训练自己的精锐私兵，不断地发展自己的领地和私兵集团。
五：在战场上，玩家只需要指挥自己和私兵部队来取得胜利。获得傲人的功绩，成为战役胜利的关键力量。
六：玩家通过不断地推关挑战，攻城略地，最终帮助自己的君主成就统一霸业，也达成自己的从龙觅封侯的宏愿！六：玩家通过不断地推关挑战，攻城略地，最终帮助自己的君主成就统一霸业，也达成自己的从龙觅封侯的野望！

死亡并非永眠。

操作炼金实验失败的产物，在杀戮与重生的反复轮回中探索一座房间不断变化的巨大城堡，解开这座阴暗孤岛上的秘密…!
当然，前提是你能战胜镇守其中的诸多守卫。

重生细胞是一款RogueVania类型的平台动作游戏。你需要在一次一次战斗中锤炼战斗技巧，精通拥有独特使用方式的各种武器，并且将翻滚和闪避等走位操作视为本能，以逃过那些出其不意出现的怪潮侵袭，迎战强横凶残的守卫和Boss。

鏖战、死亡、重生、再战

继PC与主机平台之后，《重生细胞》准备在移动平台开启战斗！

【主要特色】
• RogueVania: 逐步攻略经过悉心设计的相连关卡，体验rogue-lite类型的重复可玩性，直面肾上腺素激增的凶险场面。
• 凌厉爽快的2D动作体验：洞悉敌人的出手套路灵活走位，否则你将止步于半途，无缘城堡中隐藏的更多秘密。
• 非线性进程：在反复的死亡中突破难关，根据自己的游玩风格或心情自由选择装备与技能搭配。厌倦了臭气熏天的下水道？攀上城头呼吸新鲜的空气吧！
• 随心所欲的游玩：探索城堡的边边角角和隐秘通道，发现深藏在城堡深处的迷人景观，抑或是直冲终点？一切由你。

【针对移动平台进行的悉心优化】
• 两种攻击模式：传统与移动版新加入的自动攻击系统。
• 定制键位与触屏操作：根据你的喜好调整按钮位置及大小，通过触屏滑动来进行闪避走位…
• MFi设备以及主机控制器蓝牙连接特性支持。

hk.description:
承諾在每一個系統中展現 Sabotage 的獨特風格，《星之海》致力於為回合制戰鬥、敘事、探索與環境互動等層面注入現代化設計，同時保留經典 RPG 那份美好的懷舊氛圍與純粹的遊戲樂趣。

故事講述兩位至日之子，他們集日月之力施展星蝕魔法，這是唯一能對抗邪惡鍊金術士「血肉法師」及其可怕造物的力量。

透過打破傳統網格限制的導航系統，玩家能無縫穿梭於世界各地，並在沉浸感十足的體驗中迎戰敵人；遊戲中沒有隨機遇敵、無須切換至獨立戰場，也不需要反覆農怪。

特色
- 引人入勝的回合制戰鬥：結合看準時機的打擊、連攜攻擊、強化機制，以及具策略性的「弱點鎖定」系統，帶來沉浸式的戰鬥體驗；同樣沒有隨機遇敵、沒有戰場切換，也不強迫玩家農怪。
- 全面動態光影效果：我們自製的渲染管線突破了 2D 像素美術遊戲的極限，打造出栩栩如生、令人屏息的世界。
- 劇情豐富的冒險旅程：有時史詩壯闊、有時詼諧幽默，有時又賺人熱淚，《星之海》在探索冒險與友情等經典 RPG 主題的同時，也充滿了 Sabotage 作品一貫的意外轉折與驚喜事件。
- 一個能親手體驗的世界：航海、料理、釣魚、到酒館聽首歌，或遊玩那款惡名昭彰的桌上遊戲「輪盤」……每一個系統都經過精心設計，在致敬復古經典的同時也重新構思，帶來流暢且現代化的遊戲體驗。

專為行動裝置精心打造

- 全新操作介面：支援完整觸控的專屬手機 UI
- Game Center 成就系統
- 雲端存檔：支援 iOS 裝置間進度同步
- 相容 MFi 控制器
- 針對 iPhone 16（含 Pro Max）全面優化

重要公告：
由於記憶體容量有限，下列裝置在執行本遊戲時可能無法提供穩定的體驗，遊戲流暢度也可能受到影響：
iPhone Xr、iPhone SE（第二代，2020 年）、iPad Mini（第五代）、iPad Air（第三代）、iPad（第八代與第九代）
為了獲得最佳的遊戲體驗，我們不建議在上述機型上遊玩本遊戲。

hk.description:
《展翅翱翔》是一款屢獲殊榮的鳥類主題策略卡牌遊戲，也是一部鮮活的交互式鳥類百科，清新有趣，輕鬆愉快，適合1-5名玩家。作為鳥類發燒友，你的目標是發現和吸引更多的鳥兒加入你的自然保護區。

《展翅翱翔》（Wingspan）官方授權電子版改編，曾榮獲2019年德國年度桌面遊戲獎，權威桌遊網站BBG家庭類桌遊位列世界第一。

你們是一群鳥類發燒友——研究員、鳥類觀察家、鳥類學家和收藏家——你們一直在尋覓並試圖吸引那些最美麗的鳥類棲息到自己的野生動物保護區來。每一種鳥的加入都會讓你其中一塊棲息地上的鳥類組合變得更為豐富多彩。每一塊棲息地都各自專注於保護區生態搭建的某一重要方面。

本遊戲中，1-5名玩家在有限的回合內構建他們的自然保護區，並與其他玩家競爭。每當新的鳥類加入自然保護區，都會提升保護區在某個方面的能力，諸如鳥類產蛋、抽取新的鳥類卡牌或者收集食物。遊戲中包含170種獨特的鳥類，它們各自擁有對應它們在自然世界中所有的專長或者偏好的技能：例如，老鷹會捕獵，鵜鶘會捕魚，白鵝喜歡群居。

遊戲特色
* 輕鬆愉快的策略類卡牌遊戲，你的目標是發現和吸引最好的鳥兒。
* 同時支持單人和多人模式，最多可5名玩家組隊暢玩。
* 基於屢獲殊榮的引擎構築桌面遊戲，以卡牌為驅動，富有競爭樂趣。
* 數百隻獨特的鳥兒，配有動畫畫面和真實錄音。
* 用多種方式積攢分數，包括鳥兒、獎勵卡牌和回合目標。

在榮獲了160多個獎項和提名，其中涵蓋了英國電影學院獎(BAFTA)之際，《神界：原罪2》(Divinity: Original Sin 2)終於登陸了Mac平臺！在一個充滿邪惡、被諸神遺棄的世界中，建立一支隊伍，體驗真正的多線性遊戲玩法。每個玩家，都會擁有自己獨特的故事。你的選擇非常重要，所以一定要明智地做出選擇，要知道，你們之間只有一個人可以成為新的神！

警告：在購買遊戲前，請確認您的機器是否符合以下配置要求。

特色：
-從五個夢幻般的種族中挑選一個來構造你的角色，每個種族都有自己的獨特能力和劇情故事：精靈、矮人、蜥蜴人、人類和亡靈。
-探索一個被戰利品、寶藏、強大的力量和故事所充滿的廣袤的世界，這個世界中還充滿了令人驚奇的分支劇情。
-以自然元素為特色的回合式戰鬥：將烈焰、大地、冰霜、大氣和其他元素結合起來，對抗你的敵人。
-與動物和鬼魂交談，獲得關於世界及其秘密的獨特見解。
-最多4人在線或2人分屏合作。
-啟動遊戲時按住CMD鍵即可進行語言及遊戲選項配置。

如何確認：要確認你的Mac型號，在Apple菜單中選擇“About This Mac（關於本機）”即可。

OS系統:

- 推薦 macOS 10.14.2 Mojave (或更高版本)

us.description:
Promising the Sabotage touch in every system, Sea of Stars aims to modernize the classic RPG formula in terms of turn-based combat, storytelling, exploration and interactions with the environment, while still offering a hearty slice of nostalgia and good old, simple fun.

It tells the story of two Children of the Solstice who will combine the powers of the sun and moon to perform Eclipse Magic, the only force capable of fending off the monstrous creations of the evil alchemist known as The Fleshmancer.

Traverse seamlessly through the world with a navigation system that breaks free from the classic bound-to-the-grid tileset movement and fight enemies in an immersive take on the genre; no random encounters, no transitions to separate battlefields, and no grinding.

FEATURES
- Engaging turn-based combat: Along with timed hits, combat features combo attacks, boosting, and a strategic "locks" system, all in an immersive take on the genre; no random encounters, no transitions to separate battlefields, and no grinding.
- Full-on dynamic lighting: Our custom-made render pipeline allows the creation of a breathtaking world coming to life by pushing the limits of 2D pixel-art games.
- A story-rich adventure: Sometimes epic, sometimes silly, and other times emotional, Sea of Stars does its RPG duty of exploring classic themes of adventure and friendship, while also being chock-full of the unexpected twists and events you’d expect from a Sabotage production.
- A world you can touch: Sailing, cooking, fishing, stopping by a tavern to listen to a song or play the infamous tabletop game known as "Wheels"... every system has been designed to deliver an experience that pays respect to retro classics, while rethinking in some areas to offer a smooth and modernized experience.

CAREFULLY REDESIGNED FOR MOBILE
- Revamped interface – exclusive mobile UI with complete touch control
- Game Center achievements
- Cloud Save – Share your progress between iOS devices
- Compatible with MFi controllers
- iPhone 16 Optimization (including Pro Max)

us.description:
Dungeon Clawler is a Roguelike Claw Machine Deckbuilder. Build your unique deck, fight enemies by grabbing weapons and items from a claw machine and find special artefacts that help you on your quest to reclaim something you lost... Aim carefully to claw your way through this dungeon!

FEATURES:
- Unique Claw Machine Mechanic: Control a real-time claw machine to snatch weapons, shields, and items from the claw machine. Every grab counts, so plan your strategy and defeat enemies with precision.
- Roguelike Dungeon Exploration: Traverse procedurally generated dungeons that change with every run, offering new challenges, enemies, and treasures every time you play.
- Innovative Deckbuilding Strategy: Collect and upgrade your item pool with powerful weapons, items, and trinkets. With countless combinations, create your ultimate strategy to conquer the dungeons.
- Epic Boss Battles: Engage in intense boss battles and unlock special perks aka paws with every victory.
- Endless mode: Even after beating the dungeon boss, the run doesn’t end, but can go on forever. How deep into the dungeon can you venture?

- Unique Characters: Choose from multiple heroes, each with their own unique abilities and playstyles. Discover the best combinations to suit your dungeon-crawling strategy.
- Engaging Storyline: The evil dungeon lord has stolen your rabbit paw and you replaced it with a rusty claw. Fight your way through the dungeon to reclaim your lost limb and fortune!
- Stunning Art & Sound: Immerse yourself in the colorful, hand-drawn world of Dungeon Clawler with its dynamic soundtrack and beautifully crafted visuals.

WHY PLAY DUNGEON CLAWLER?
Dungeon Clawler brings together the strategic depth of deckbuilders with the thrilling unpredictability of roguelike dungeon crawlers and the fun of a claw machine mechanic. Each run offers something new, with endless strategies to discover and enemies to defeat. If you're seeking a fresh deck-builder with infinite replayability, this is the game for you.

EARLY ACCESS: HELP SHAPE THE FUTURE!
Dungeon Clawler is currently in Early Access, and we're committed to making it even better with your feedback! Expect frequent updates, new content, and improvements as we continue to enhance the game. By joining now, you can help shape the future of Dungeon Clawler and be part of our growing community.

JOIN THE ADVENTURE TODAY!
Download Dungeon Clawler now and begin your journey through ever-changing dungeons. Can you master the claw and reclaim your paw? The dungeon awaits!

ABOUT STRAY FAWN
We are an indie game development studio from Zurich, Switzerland. Dungeon Clawler is our fourth game and highly appreciate your support!

Wingspan is a relaxing, award-winning strategy card game about birds for 1 to 5 players. Each bird you play extends a chain of powerful combinations in one of your three habitats. Your goal is to discover and attract the best birds to your network of wildlife preserves. 

You are bird enthusiasts—researchers, bird watchers, ornithologists, and collectors—seeking to discover and attract the best birds to your network of wildlife preserves. Each bird extends a chain of powerful combinations in one of your habitats. Each habitat focuses on a key aspect of the growth of your preserves.

In Wingspan up to 5 players compete to build up their nature preserves in a limited number of turns. Each beautiful bird that you add to your preserve makes you better at laying eggs, drawing cards, or gathering food. Many of the 170 unique birds have powers that echo real life: your hawks will hunt, your pelicans will fish, and your geese will form a flock.

Features
- Relaxing strategy card game where your goal is to discover and attract the best birds.
- Single player and multiplayer modes for up to five players.
- Based on award winning, competitive, card-driven, engine-building board game.
- Hundreds of unique, animated birds with their real life sound recordings.
- Multiple ways to accumulate points with birds, bonus cards and end-of-round goals.

tr.description:
Promising the Sabotage touch in every system, Sea of Stars aims to modernize the classic RPG formula in terms of turn-based combat, storytelling, exploration and interactions with the environment, while still offering a hearty slice of nostalgia and good old, simple fun.

It tells the story of two Children of the Solstice who will combine the powers of the sun and moon to perform Eclipse Magic, the only force capable of fending off the monstrous creations of the evil alchemist known as The Fleshmancer.

Traverse seamlessly through the world with a navigation system that breaks free from the classic bound-to-the-grid tileset movement and fight enemies in an immersive take on the genre; no random encounters, no transitions to separate battlefields, and no grinding.

FEATURES
- Engaging turn-based combat: Along with timed hits, combat features combo attacks, boosting, and a strategic "locks" system, all in an immersive take on the genre; no random encounters, no transitions to separate battlefields, and no grinding.
- Full-on dynamic lighting: Our custom-made render pipeline allows the creation of a breathtaking world coming to life by pushing the limits of 2D pixel-art games.
- A story-rich adventure: Sometimes epic, sometimes silly, and other times emotional, Sea of Stars does its RPG duty of exploring classic themes of adventure and friendship, while also being chock-full of the unexpected twists and events you’d expect from a Sabotage production.
- A world you can touch: Sailing, cooking, fishing, stopping by a tavern to listen to a song or play the infamous tabletop game known as "Wheels"... every system has been designed to deliver an experience that pays respect to retro classics, while rethinking in some areas to offer a smooth and modernized experience.

Mas suas tarefas necessitam que outros morram...

Você só tem 7 dias
O que você irá escolher?

Experimente está história que provoca a imaginação agora mesmo.
